hook: On Mars, your sunset would be blue.
title: On Mars, the sunset turns blue
description:
Rover cameras have photographed sunsets on Mars where the sky around the setting Sun glows blue. Fine dust in the air scatters light differently from Earth's air, flipping the colours we know. Part of the If You Were in Space series.

#Shorts #Mars #IfYouWereInSpace
comment_prompt: Would you watch it live? Yes or no
